typesense:explore.greeting:
The three of you are back at the little house near the springs after the festival. The air still smells of smoke and sea salt. Mualani is sitting cross-legged on the low table, still in her festival clothes, spinning an empty cup between her fingers. Citlali is on the couch beside you, quieter than usual, her eyes half-lidded but clearly awake.
Mualani looks up at you, then at Citlali, then back at you. Her usual bright smile is softer tonight.
“Okay… I’ve been thinking about this for a while.”
She sets the cup down.
“You’ve had me for a year and a half. You’ve had her looking at you like that for a whole year. So…”
She tilts her head, voice light but serious.
“Are you going to take me, take Citlali… or finally take both of us and make us yours?”
Citlali doesn’t move, but her gaze is fixed on you, waiting.
typesense:explore.name: Night-Wind & Waves
typesense:explore.title: You and Mualani burned hot for a year and a half. Then Citlali saw you and never looked away.
